name: Heirloom Tomatoes
shortDescription: Sweet, deeply complex, low-acid heritage tomatoes picked dead-ripe off the vine.
description: These prized heritage varieties trace back generations. With thin skins, rich marbled flesh, and a complex savory-sweet balance that commercial grocery store varieties can never match, they are meant to be sliced thick and served simply with sea salt and fresh olive oil.
storageTip: Never refrigerate! Store stem-side down at room temperature away from direct sunlight to preserve delicate aromatics and juicy texture.
flavorNotes: Earthy, wine-like sweetness with smoky undertones and pleasant acidity.

name: Rainbow Carrots
shortDescription: Sweet, crunchy heirloom carrots in vivid purple, golden yellow, and deep orange hues.
description: Pulled crisp from the sandy soil of Malir and coastal riverbeds. Loaded with natural sweetness, beta-carotene, and anthocyanins. Wonderful raw with hummus or slow-roasted with coriander and honey.
storageTip: Remove green tops and store roots wrapped in a damp paper towel in the crisper drawer for up to 3 weeks.
flavorNotes: Crisp, sweet, floral and earthy with honey undertones.

name: Garden Herbs
shortDescription: Hand-picked bundles of sweet basil, fragrant garden mint (pudina), and fresh coriander.
description: Grown in nutrient-rich organic compost along the riverbed plots. Cut fresh at dawn for market morning, delivering intense aroma and culinary essential oils for chutneys, salads, and curries.
storageTip: Trim stems and place upright in a jar with an inch of fresh water on your countertop.
flavorNotes: Aromatic, peppery clove, sharp refreshing menthol, citrus.

name: Market Berries
shortDescription: Naturally vine-ripened berries with deep crimson centers and perfume-like sweetness.
description: Grown without chemical ripening agents and harvested only when fully red and sweet. Sweet, juicy, and fragrant through the core, bursting with sunshine and natural vitamin C.
storageTip: Do not wash until ready to eat. Store dry in a single layer with a paper towel in the refrigerator.
flavorNotes: Floral strawberry sweetness with crisp natural tartness.

name: Organic Tender Greens & Spinach
shortDescription: Crisp morning-harvested baby spinach and chard loaded with iron and magnesium.
description: Harvested daily by local Malir growers. Succulent green leaves bursting with minerals, crisp stems, and vibrant earthy flavor.
storageTip: Keep in a dry container with a clean paper towel in the crisper drawer.

name: Pure Sidr & Mountain Wild Honey
shortDescription: Raw unfiltered golden nectar harvested directly from foothill hives without heat treatment.
description: Collected from bees foraging in coastal and foothill berry blossoms. Rich in pollen, enzymes, and natural antibacterial properties.
storageTip: Store sealed at room temperature. If crystallized, gently warm jar in warm water.
flavorNotes: Butterscotch, floral warmth, clean herbal finish.

name: Farmstead Dairy & Fresh Buffalo Milk
shortDescription: Pure unadulterated farm milk, rich yogurt (dahi), and cultured desi butter.
description: Sourced every dawn from nearby pasture-fed cattle farms on the outskirts of Malir. Free from preservatives and rich in cream.
storageTip: Keep strictly chilled below 4°C and boil within 24 hours of purchase.
flavorNotes: Rich, creamy, slightly sweet and velvety.

name: Wood-Fired Bakery Bread & Naan
shortDescription: Stone-milled whole wheat bread and sourdough baked in brick hearth ovens.
description: Slow cold fermentation crafted using locally milled flours. Crisp crust with an airy crumb and gentle nutty flavor.
storageTip: Store cut-side down on a wooden cutting board or bread bin.
